urban-all-classes - one of each class, urban relativities
rural-all-classes - one of each class, rural relativities
declined-young-driver - youngest driver exactly 23 - declined
rated-driver-24 - youngest driver 24 - just above the exclusion
declined-out-of-state - regular out-of-state operations - declined
